hook: Log kya kahenge? Pehle ye suno
emotion: calm, warm and intense, like a heart-to-heart talk

shots.dialogue: Agar tum apna sapna sirf isliye rok rahe ho ki *log kya kahenge*, toh suno.
Wahi log kal tumhari *kamyabi* ki kahani sunayenge, jo aaj tum par hans rahe hain.
Toh darr chhodo aur *shuru* karo. Ye video us dost ko bhejo jise zaroorat hai.
